abstract: Sperm cryopreservation before chemotherapy in young males is recommended because of chemotherapy's gonadotoxic effects. However, many patients miss sperm banking, and consequently are often sterile. Two azoospermic patients presented to us after chemotherapy, and we obtained sperm from them by testicular sperm extraction (TESE). One patient was 32 years old and had been treated with six cycles of cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin (BEP) chemotherapy and one cycle of high-dose chemotherapy for stage III non-seminoma. Histopathology of the testicular specimen showed germinal aplasia with focal islands of full spermatogenesis. Although two intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) cycles were performed, pregnancy was not achieved. The other patient was 33 years old who was treated with four cycles of BEP chemotherapy for stage II seminoma. Histopathology of the testicular specimen showed Sertoli-cell-only syndrome. Ongoing pregnancy was achieved after one ICSI cycle. TESE should be considered in patients with persistent azoospermia after chemotherapy if frozen sperm samples are not available.
abstract_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後も無精子症が持続する男性2例が来院し、精巣内精子採取術(TESE)により精子を採取した。症例1は32歳で、病期IIIの非セミノーマに対しシスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシン(BEP)化学療法を6サイクル、大量化学療法を1サイクル受けていた。精巣標本の病理組織学的検査で、胚細胞の無形成と限局的な完全精子形成の島がみられた。顕微授精(ICSI)を2サイクル実施したが、妊娠は得られなかった。症例2は33歳で、病期IIのセミノーマに対しBEP化学療法を4サイクル受けていた。精巣標本ではセルトリ細胞のみ症候群がみられた。ICSIを1サイクル行い、妊娠が継続した。凍結精子の検体が利用できない場合、化学療法後も無精子症が持続する患者にはTESEを考慮すべきである。
